title: T1584.002 — Compromise Infrastructure - DNS Server
subtitle: Watch an attacker take over a DNS server, rewrite the record of a brand domain, and send an employee to a fake site - while the SOC cross-checks the answers and restores the truth.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker takes over a DNS server, rewrites the record of a brand domain, sends an employee to a fake site, and the SOC cross-checks the answers and restores the records. A written step-by-step version follows below.
